# Spec 02 - Application layer (`emulator/modules/<id>/application/`)

**No files yet** (YAGNI). The emulator gets its application services together with the first emulated service - they have no
job before that.

## What comes later (not generated by Part A - it is Part B of this same skill)
Each emulated service is a module of the emulator application, `emulator/modules/<id>/` (same id as the API module it
serves, namespace `app\modules\<id>`, layout as in `docs/modules/README.md` §3) - generated by **Part B** of this
skill (`generate-emulator` SKILL.md, section "Part B") from that module's specs
(`development/<name>/specs/module.service.yaml`, `module.service.md`), never into `emulator/application/` (this
directory, Part A's). Its application layer has one use case per emulated service method:
- **handle the module's request:** check the signature and the body parameters, save this module's own process record,
  answer with the emulated service's response (with its remote status);
- **schedule the callback** (for service methods that have one): push a queue job with a fixed 5-second delay
  (`docs/architecture/flow.md` §6a, RabbitMQ TTL + dead-letter exchange, no plugin) instead of sending it inline; a
  separate consumer (`emulator-queue-worker`) sends it after the delay, to the `callback_url` received in the init
  request (flow.md §1a) - never posted from the use case that answered the request.

Rules and test conventions for this layer: `generate-emulator` SKILL.md §B.3.1-B.3.2 and §B.4 (domain stays pure PHP;
the use case may depend only on the domain layer plus the queue job contract; no Yii otherwise, no ActiveRecord). This
spec file stays as a pointer - do not regenerate its own content when the first module's application layer is written.

## Checks (must print nothing, also while the layer is empty)
```bash
grep -rnE 'Yii::|use yii[\]|extends (ActiveRecord|Model|Component|BaseObject)|[\]infrastructure[\]' emulator/modules/*/application 2>/dev/null
```
